title: Have You Ever...?
gist_ar: سلمى بتحكي عن تجاربها في الحياة.
text: My name is Salma and I love new experiences. I have been to four countries, but I have never flown in a small plane. I have ridden a camel twice, and I have swum in the Red Sea. I have already tried Indian food, but I haven't eaten Chinese food yet. Last year I won a prize at school for my English. I have met many people from abroad, and I have seen two concerts in Cairo. My brother has done more than me: he has visited seven countries!

questions.q: How many countries has Salma been to?
